subject: Re: MAP & Eval: Access commitments and environment setup
messages:
From: Samar Patel <samar.patel@medflow.ai>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft + environment ask

Rachel —

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our MAP, MedFlow is targeting a 6-week eval with two main goals: latency/price head-to-head vs our current provider, and a closed-loop integration for inference via the private VPC. To get the environment live we need the following from Redwood so we can start provisioning on our side:

- API key(s) scoped to org "MedFlow-POC" (ephemeral keys are OK)
- Org setup / tenant id so we can configure service accounts
- IP allowlist for the test runners (we will give you a list of CI egress IPs)
- VPC peering instructions and required CIDR ranges

I attached our initial MAP (MedFlow_MAP_v1.pdf) and a short networking inventory.

Can you confirm an earliest date you can issue keys and the contact who owns peering? We want to sync timelines with our infra team and legal.

Best,
Samar
Principal SRE, MedFlow AI
attachments: MedFlow_MAP_v1.pdf, medflow-network-inventory.xlsx

From: rachel_kim@redwood.com
To: Samar Patel <samar.patel@medflow.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-26T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + environment ask

Samar —

Appreciate the clear list. We can get started immediately. Proposed plan and owners below:

- API keys: temporary test key within 48 hours (owner: rachel_kim)
- Org/tenant setup: we will provision an org "medflow-eval" and share tenant id (owner: ben_carter) by EOD next business day
- IP allowlist: send your CI egress CIDRs; our infra will validate and add (owner: grace_oconnor)
- VPC peering: engineering handoff doc + peering ranges and security group template (owner: grace_oconnor). Peering worksheet attached.

Timeline suggestion: keys + tenant id in 2 business days -> IP allowlist validation within 3 business days -> peering window scheduled (1–2 days) -> smoke tests and perf runs the following week. If that fits your SLA for the eval we can lock dates and mark milestones in the MAP.

Two asks before we start:
1) Confirm list of IPs for test runners (CSV ok).
2) Point us to the internal contact who will complete the peering request and sign the ENA (networking attachment).

I attached our networking checklist and a short runbook to speed the handoff.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | rachel_kim@redwood.com
attachments: redwood-networking-checklist.csv

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-27T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + environment ask

Rachel / Grace —

Thanks — I'll take point on the org provisioning and HubSpot side. I'll create the MedFlow eval org and post the tenant id to the deal in HubSpot (RDW-2026-457).

Notes:
- I'll request a temporary test key bound to the medflow-eval org and limit tokens and duration (48h rotation by default).
- Pricing: we'll leave it on metered host but I'll prepare a short note on dedicated vs hosted for the MAP milestone call.

Grace: can you triage the peering worksheet and ping the infra team for a tentative peering window next Wed/Thu? If we need a longer blackout window, we'll propose Fri night.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood
attachments: (none)

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Samar Patel <samar.patel@medflow.ai>, rachel_kim@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-28T10:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + environment ask

Samar —

I've reviewed the worksheet. A couple of technical clarifications before we schedule peering:
1) Which AWS region is your VPC in? (we support peering across us-east-1/us-west-2 with minimal routing config)
2) Confirm the CIDR you want Redwood to route (avoid overlapping subnets).
3) Do you require cross-account IAM roles for service account provisioning? If so, we'll draft the IAM trust policy.

If you can reply with the region and CIDR sample I will get our infra to propose a maintenance window. For the IP allowlist we can accept a CSV; we'll map it to the egress ranges and respond within 24 hours.

Also copying our legal contact for the ENA and standard peering addendum.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Samar Patel <samar.patel@medflow.ai>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@medflow.ai
Date: 2026-04-30T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + environment ask

Thanks all — quick answers below and next steps:

- Region: us-west-2
- CIDR: 10.14.0.0/16 (we confirm no overlap with your side)
- IAM: yes, we'll need a cross-account role for our automation pipeline. I attached a short template of the CloudFormation snippet we use.
- IP allowlist: attaching the CI egress list now (see docusign-request-12345.pdf placeholder — actual CSV in thread).

Legal: please expect a short ENA and SOW redline this week (contracts@medflow.ai). We are aiming to sign by next Friday so we can hit the 6-week evaluation start date. Once legal gives the go-ahead, we will request the peering window.

Samar
Principal SRE, MedFlow AI
attachments: docusign-request-12345.pdf, medflow-ci-egress.csv
